title: Degreewise section products identify localized external cochains
statement: For a ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] with commutative ring sheaf R, an object U, and arbitrary integer-indexed module-sheaf cochain complexes L,I [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], let S be the abelian-group complex of sections at U of their sheaf Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex], res restriction to U, and π the projections chosen in homComplex_exists. There exist additive equivalences e_n from S.X n to the external degree-n cochains between res L and res I for every integer n. For each x,p,q with p+n=q and localized object W, the component (e_n x).v p q at W is the evaluated projection π(L,I,n,p,q) applied to x, evaluated at W. This asserts degreewise products only, with no cycles, boundaries, cohomology or homotopy-category maps.

source.place: Tag 0A8X, Section 21.34, construction and differential of Hom complexes; Tag 0A8Y, Equation 21.34.0.1

proof.text: Apply product preservation to the chosen fan in homComplex_exists: forgetting module sheaves, evaluating at U, and forgetting modules to abelian groups preserve the integer-indexed product. Its evaluated projections identify degree-n sections with the product of internal Hom sections at U.

By the construction of internal Hom, each factor is the group of presheaf-module maps on C/U. The fully faithful forgetful functor on localized module sheaves identifies it with the group of localized sheaf-module maps. Families indexed by p are external degree-n cochains; q is transported along p+n=q. The product universal property gives inverse maps, proves addition preservation and the displayed projection formula.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of the degreewise product and differential arguments preceding Equation 21.34.0.1

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_sections_cochains
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (L I : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)) ℤ) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R
    let E := (SheafOfModules.forget R₀ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R₀.obj (op U) ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R₀.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    letI := module_overFunctor_preservesZero R₀ U
    let res := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R₀ U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let S := E.obj (homComplex (R := R) L I)
    let π := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (homComplex_exists.{u, v, max u v, max u v} (J := J) (R := R)))
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℤ, S.X n ≃+
        CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain (res.obj L) (res.obj I) n,
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : S.X n) (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ),
        ((e n x).v p q hpq).val.app W =
          (((π L I n p q hpq).val.app (op U)) x).app W
